# Disagreement Log — Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 6

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Chapter:** SHE 006 — Vision 2, Chapter 2
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

### 1. V. 2 — "God of powers" vs. "God of Powers" vs. "God of all Powers"
- **EMET:** "God of powers" — lowercase
- **LOGOS:** "God of Powers" — capitalized divine title
- **PNEUMA:** "God of all Powers" — adds "all"
- **Decision:** "God of Powers" — preserve as divine title; PNEUMA adds to the text

### 2. V. 3 — "ordinances" vs. "commandments"
- **EMET:** "ordinances"
- **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "commandments"
- **Decision:** "commandments" — consistent decision throughout (entolai = commandments)

### 3. V. 4 — "single-hearted" vs. "sincere of heart" vs. "wholehearted"
- **EMET:** "single-hearted" — literal for haplous
- **LOGOS:** "sincere of heart" — interpretive
- **PNEUMA:** "wholehearted" — dynamic
- **Decision:** "single-hearted" — preserve the technical antonym to "double-minded"; these are paired Hermaic concepts

### 4. V. 4 — "stand as enemies" vs. "are as enemies of the elect"
- **EMET:** "are as enemies of the elect"
- **LOGOS:** "are opposed to the elect"
- **PNEUMA:** "are enemies of the elect" (implicit)
- **Decision:** SOPHIA uses "stand as enemies of the elect" — slight improvement for clarity

### 5. V. 5 — The list of titles: "building up" vs. "upbuilding"
- **EMET:** "building up"
- **LOGOS:** "building up"
- **PNEUMA:** "upbuilding"
- **Decision:** "building-up" with hyphen — oikodomē as a compound action

### 6. V. 5 — Tower on water introduction
- All three agree the tower is on water/waters
- Minor word order variations; no significant disagreement
- SOPHIA harmonizes

**Total disagreements: 5**
